title: Boot-recovery worker panics after the batch budget expires are not re-raised to the owning test
outcome: In test builds, recover_prepared_engram_sessions_after_boot (src/engram_host_adapter.rs) records each recovery worker's caught panic and re-raises it on the calling thread when the coordinator returns, so the owning test fails. A worker still running when the batch budget expires finishes on the late path (finish_late_engram_restart_recovery) after that list is read, so its panic reaches only stderr. The fix covers late workers in test builds as well, for example a state-level failure channel that the test helpers check, or a test-owned completion guard. The production coordinator's bounded behaviour stays unchanged.
acceptance: Boot-recovery worker panics after the batch budget expires are not re-raised to the owning test is done
